digest.component_or_area: MCP model schema generation and validation
propositions: BridgeFsckOut pydantic model declares three properties but bridge_fsck.schema.json defines four, with binding_drift field missing from the model
VerifySignatureResultOut marks algorithm, head_sha, and key_id as optional in the model but the schema requires all three
MCP model layer hand-mirrors five committed JSON schemas with no generator or drift gate, unlike the TypedDict layer which is auto-generated and CI-validated
False documentation in _mcp_models.py claims cross-interface schema tests pin models to canonical schemas, but no such tests exist for BridgeFsckOut, GroundingInfoOut, or WorkflowRunOut
MCP models must be generated from schemas or covered by equivalent --check drift gate to prevent future contract defects
